core: Colony-stimulating factor signalling in myeloid development
qualifier: M-CSF/GM-CSF driven monocyte-macrophage and bone marrow cell expansion
name: M-CSF and GM-CSF signalling in monocyte-macrophage development
rationale: Members cover CSF1/GM-CSF signalling and production, interleukin receptor SHC signalling, and monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell differentiation plus bone marrow cell proliferation and survival, whereas confusables centre on G-CSF-driven granulocyte/neutrophil differentiation or osteoclasts.

qualifier: follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation and corpus luteum formation and regression
name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: All members concern the female ovarian cycle (antral follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, estrous cycle, gonadotropin restraint), distinguishing it from confusables built on testis (Leydig, Sertoli) and gonadotropin/activin hormone signalling.

qualifier: histidine, threonine and tyrosine, with pyrimidine base breakdown
name: Histidine, threonine and tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid catabolic and metabolic terms anchored by histidine, threonine and tyrosine degradation (plus pyrimidine nucleobase and amide catabolism), while confusables centre on phenylalanine/tyrosine or proline/glycine metabolism and lack histidine and threonine.

qualifier: potassium channel families driving plateau, repolarisation and resting potential
name: Potassium channels in cardiac action potential repolarisation and rest
rationale: Members are cardiac action potential phases 1-4 with the voltage-gated, inward-rectifier and two-pore potassium channels that shape them, whereas confusables emphasise depolarisation, conduction-system and atrial/AV node events or other potassium channels.

core: Glomerular podocyte and renal epithelial structure
qualifier: microvillus and brush border assembly
name: Podocyte filtration barrier and microvillus brush border assembly
rationale: Members cover podocyte/glomerular epithelial development, nephrin interactions, basement membrane and albumin uptake together with microvillus and brush border assembly, which distinguishes it from glomerular mesangial/endothelial and general epithelial polarity confusables.

qualifier: mitochondria and endolysosomes alongside neuronal synaptic cargo
name: Cytoskeletal transport of mitochondria, endolysosomes and neuronal synaptic cargo
rationale: All members concern motor-driven positioning of organelles and vesicles (mitochondria, endosomes/lysosomes, synaptic and dense core vesicles) along microtubules and actin, whereas confusables focus on kinesins and tubulin modification, microtubule severing, or lysosomal fusion and autophagy.

qualifier: with tooth and tissue mineralization disorders
name: Inorganic anion transport and tooth mineralization disorders
rationale: Members combine bicarbonate, SLC26, phosphate, sulfate, iodide and oxalate transport and their channelopathies with enamel, dentin and ectopic calcification diseases, distinguishing it from confusables on proton/pH regulation and sodium-phosphate cotransport.

qualifier: CD28 costimulation opposed by CTLA4 and BTLA co-inhibition
name: CD28 costimulation and co-inhibitory checkpoints in T cells
rationale: All members concern CD28-dependent costimulatory signalling and its restraint by CTLA4, BTLA and negative TCR regulation, while confusables cover TCR/BCR proximal signalling and T cell activation modules without costimulatory receptors.

qualifier: positive regulation of the stress-activated kinase cascade
name: Positive regulation of JNK stress-activated kinase signalling
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of the JNK/SAPK cascade, distinguishing it from confusables on NOD and TLR-driven TAK1/IKK and NF-kappaB activation.

qualifier: Hippo-YAP/TAZ, RUNX3 and cancer-mutant TGF-beta receptors and SMADs
name: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and cancer-mutant TGF-beta/SMAD tumour suppression
rationale: Members combine Hippo-YAP/TAZ signalling and cell density sensing, RUNX3 target regulation (CDKN1A, BIM, p14-ARF) and cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors and SMADs, whereas confusables are wild-type TGF-beta/activin/TGFBR3 signalling without Hippo or RUNX3.

qualifier: initiation with checkpoint signalling and replication-coupled repair
name: S-phase DNA replication with checkpoint and replication-coupled repair
rationale: Members cover replication initiation, DNA unwinding, polymerase regulation, intra-S checkpoint, break-induced replication and recombination-intermediate resolution with E2F/mitosis gene sets, distinguishing it from confusables on telomere maintenance, cohesion, DNA topology or the broad cell cycle.

qualifier: biogenesis and protein import together with fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, protein import and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members span peroxisomal protein targeting and import, fission, and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids, whereas confusables centre on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogen and omega-3/6 lipid metabolism without peroxisome biogenesis.

qualifier: spermine/spermidine interconversion and oxidation
name: Spermine and spermidine interconversion and oxidative catabolism
rationale: All members concern spermine and spermidine metabolism via polyamine oxidase-driven interconversion, distinguishing it from the putrescine synthesis/ODC and polyamine transport confusable and unrelated cofactor or amino acid themes.

qualifier: integrin activation driving neutrophil and T cell diapedesis
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial extravasation
rationale: Members cover integrin activation and integrin-mediated adhesion, leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and its negative regulation, and neutrophil/T cell extravasation and diapedesis, while confusables centre on PECAM1/shear stress signalling or monocyte activation.

qualifier: electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation with ROS output
name: Regulation of mitochondrial electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: All members regulate respiratory chain electron transport, oxidative phosphorylation, cellular respiration and associated ROS production, distinguishing it from confusables about oxidative stress responses and hydrogen peroxide-induced apoptosis.

qualifier: synaptic vesicles, dense core vesicles and receptor complexes
name: Axo-dendritic transport of synaptic cargo and dense core vesicles
rationale: All members concern directed transport of synaptic vesicles, dense core vesicles, receptor complexes and presynaptic proteins within axons and dendrites, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial/organelle transport or the local synaptic vesicle cycle and endocytosis.

qualifier: cytosolic calcium clearance by sarcoplasmic reticulum reuptake and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Cardiac calcium clearance by sarcoplasmic reticulum reuptake and sodium exchange
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic calcium via SR/ER calcium uptake, SERCA regulation and Na+/Ca2+ exchange, supporting relaxation and contractile force, whereas confusables centre on ryanodine-receptor calcium release, heart rate and negative contractile regulation.

qualifier: antiviral restriction and B cell antibody diversification
name: Cytidine deamination in antiviral restriction and B cell antibody diversification
rationale: Members cover APOBEC/AID cytidine-to-uridine editing and DNA deamination in viral restriction and somatic hypermutation, together with V(D)J recombination and early B cell development, distinguishing it from confusables on general DNA repair, alkylation reversal and demethylation.

qualifier: ephrin and Sema3A signalling with neurite remodelling
name: Ephrin and Sema3A repulsive axon guidance and neurite remodelling
rationale: Members combine ephrin/EPH and Sema3A repulsion, growth cone collapse and microtubule destabilisation with fasciculation, nerve branching, neuron remodelling and synapse pruning, whereas confusables centre on L1/NCAM adhesion, netrin, Sema4D or collateral sprouting.

core: Inhibition of plasma membrane ion flux
qualifier: calcium and potassium channel activity in excitable muscle cells
name: Inhibition of plasma-membrane calcium and potassium channel activity
rationale: Most members negatively regulate calcium and potassium movement across the plasma membrane, high voltage-gated calcium channels, action potentials and channel membrane targeting, distinguishing it from confusables describing cardiac action potential phases, SR calcium handling or sodium transport.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR2 b/c isoforms
name: Ligand binding and activation of FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoforms
rationale: All four members are ligand binding and activation of the b and c splice isoforms of FGFR1 and FGFR2, distinguishing it from confusables on FGFR3/4, downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and activating mutants.

qualifier: megakaryocyte rather than erythroid fate
name: Megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet production
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte development and its positive and negative regulation, platelet morphogenesis, RUNX1 megakaryocyte genes and suppression of erythroid differentiation, whereas confusables centre on erythroid differentiation or haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells.

qualifier: MAO and COMT degradation of dopamine and serotonin
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter degradation by MAO and COMT
rationale: All members concern catabolism of biogenic amines (dopamine, serotonin, catechols) by monoamine oxidase and COMT, distinguishing it from confusables on monoamine transport, reuptake and biosynthesis.

qualifier: ORC-CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and its control
name: Pre-replicative complex assembly and origin licensing control
rationale: All members concern assembly, activation and restraint of the pre-replicative complex at origins (ORC, CDC6, Orc1 removal, E2F-enabled inhibition), distinguishing it from confusables on replication checkpoints and E2F/G1-S transcription.

Members mix responses to ethanol, ether, anaesthetics, antibiotics and drugs with agmatine biosynthesis, negative regulation of nitric oxide and amine metabolism, hypoxia and oxidative stress responses and developmental apoptosis, sharing no single nameable biological theme.
